mentions.name: Humansmap
mentions.description: Graph visualization of 7M+ people and 3M+ organizations built on Wikidata, letting users visualize up to 1k entities associated with an organization or a person's graph of relatives, partners, PhD advisors, and connected organizations; includes a feed section for exploring family dynasties, organization memberships, and interesting relationships, optimized for mobile use.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://humansmap.com/?lb_tab=orgs

7M+ people and 3M+ organizations mapped, you can visualize entities associated with an organizations up to 1k nodes, or visualize someones graph visualization(relatives, partners, phd advisors, org connected to entity.
Wikidata based.
There is also a feed section: https://humansmap.com/?feed=1 
Better for mobile use, here you can explore family dynasties, org memberships, interesting relationships.
